scope: Task 05: version-aware tables cycle/menu, disabled refusal and reset, cmdline branch structure, system-relation toggle, keybindings, help, and their tests
summary: Approved with zero findings. The t cycle and T menu implement the PG19 boundary and legacy behavior; the disabled item sends nothing, preserves the current view, emits one NOTICE branch, and closes/resets the menu. Every enabled menuTables arm and the shared hotkey path have exactly one printCmdline call by branch inspection. All four toggle literals are consistent, the lowercase t binding is unchanged, T is bound once on sysstat, and help has one t description in the required w,W/S adjacency with one formatting placeholder. Tests exercise real state, rendered menu/help content, channel behavior, and bound handlers rather than mocks or implementation strings. Visible cmdline counts are intentionally not claimed from the unobservable g.Update unit seam; SC-5 through SC-8 remain manual acceptance work.

verification.evidence: The requested filter passed with named toggle/menu/keybinding/help subtests. Because Go test filters are case-sensitive, this filter did not select Test_tablesNextView, Test_switchViewTo, or lowercase Test_toggleSysTables; those were run explicitly in the next check rather than inferred from this green run.

All eight tablesNextView version/current-view cases, all 33 switchViewTo cases, both toggle directions plus activity no-op, enabled/disabled/out-of-range menu selections, both keybindings and their real handlers, and help adjacency passed. The same focused set passed under the race detector (ok top 1.034s).
